note: The strongest difference is in how each pipeline absorbed the breaking /todos auth change into the earlier specs' suites for 06-api-keys. X seeded a fixed key hash into every store-test file and rewrote spec 05's AC-1 expected document, AC-2 seed section and AC-4 file-creation trigger to fit (X.diff:309-317, 336, 359-364, 402-405), while keeping spec 04's AC-2 at 200 via an advancing clock (X.diff:280-287). Y minted the key in memory after detaching the store (Y.diff:302-304) so the persistence assertions stayed byte-for-byte what spec 05 locked, at the cost of flipping spec 04 AC-2's first response to 401 (Y.diff:275). For 04 the two diffs are essentially the same code, and for 05 the deciding factor was X's extra D7 test that 400/404 responses never touch disk (X.diff:224-241) against Y's safer commit-after-rename store write (Y.diff:84-88).
